submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.0733% at index 2 (Sb 0.167). Neighbouring points were lower: index 0 (Sb 0.12) gave 0.053% and index 5 (Sb 0.23) gave 0.054%, so the maximum sits near Sb ~0.17. Sb-rich compositions were an order of magnitude lower. XRD on indices 0, 5 and 9 was dominated by FTO-like reflections and did not tell the phases apart.
